questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Balantioides coli?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Trophozoites or cysts in stool. Fresh wet mounts at 100–400× demonstrate large, ciliated motile trophozoites; permanent preparations support morphology.
